review_candidates.title: Senior Hosting Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Run the hosted estate Own the day-to-day operation of hosted customer environments: patching, backups, monitoring, capacity and change Act as the senior escalation point for hosting incidents, and drive them to resolution with the product teams where needed Run disaster recovery tests on schedule and fix what they find Keep runbooks and operational documentation current Cloud services and cost Manage our cloud subscriptions and services for hosted customers, mainly Azure Tra
eligibility_evidence: We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Until then, the Kubernetes Engineer sits in the Eloquence product engineering team and you will work closely with them Automate repetitive work, and improve monitoring and alerting Provide evidence and controls for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification, working with our process and compliance lead Requirements Essential Several years running production customer environments in Azure, at a software vendor or managed service provider (AZ-104 or equivalent level) Hands-on infrastructure as code, using Terraform, Bicep or similar Working experience with Kubernetes and containers, ideally Azure Kubernetes Service Strong Windows and Linux server administration, plus relational databases (for example SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL) Backup, disaster recovery and monitoring tooling in practice, not just in theory Comfortable talking to customers about their service, and calm under incident pressure
